bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and clutches or fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with one pocket are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with no more than one pocket
Empty hydration packs with no more than one extra pocket
prohibited: Bags that are not clear and larger than 6" x 9"
Any bag larger than 12" x 6" x 12"
Hydration packs with more than two pockets
bagPolicy.note: All guests and bags are searched every time you enter. Confiscated or surrendered items are not held or returned. The official policy page was last written for the 2025 festival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at BottleRock Napa Valley can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare area at 3rd and Randolph Streets. Allow a walk of less than half a mile to the festival.

concessions.note: BottleRock Napa Valley offers a diverse range of food and drink options, featuring local and renowned chefs, restaurants, and wineries. Attendees can enjoy gourmet dishes, artisanal snacks, and a variety of beverages, including craft beers and fine wines. The festival is known for its culinary stage where celebrity chefs and musicians collaborate for unique cooking demonstrations.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Stop at the Accessibility Services tent just past the main entrance off Third Street for a free accessibility wristband; there's no pre-registration or accessibility ticket, and one companion wristband is issued per guest with a disability. Guests with disabilities and one companion can use the accessible entry lane at the main entrance. Drivers with a valid placard can drop off at the Accessible Loading & Unloading Zone at First Street and Juarez Street.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in BottleRock Napa Valley's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Wristbands are shipped to ticket holders before the festival, and no printed tickets are issued. Your wristband is your ticket into the festival.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors open at 11:30 a.m. Guests with disabilities and up to one companion can use the accessible entry lane at the main entrance off Third Street, then visit the Accessibility Services tent just inside.
